listing.name: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King — DQ8Recomp (Sinan-Karakaya)
listing.original_game_title: Dragon Quest VIII: Journey of the Cursed King
listing.summary: Build Dragon Quest VIII locally from your USA ISO using the upstream launcher. Upstream reports startup, saves and field gameplay; sustained play and a complete playthrough have not been confirmed. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-21207 ISO. The required revision and hash are not confirmed; check the upstream instructions before preparing your files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the released launcher for your platform with your own USA ISO. It downloads the required tools and compiles the game on your machine; the launcher is not a ready-to-play game.

warnings: Upstream reports startup, saves and field gameplay after a local build. Sustained play and a complete playthrough have not been confirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
